sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Multilingual Customer Inbound Helpdesk and Outbound Tele-Sales BPO

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Melanesian Spearhead Group (MSG) Trade Agreement among Vanuatu, Fiji, Solomon Islands, and Papua New Guinea (in force)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER) Plus (provisionally in force since 13 December 2020)
Republic of Vanuatu and People's Republic of China Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 11 April 2006, in force)
No comprehensive double taxation avoidance agreements are in force; Vanuatu maintains a territorial zero income tax system for International Companies.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 11 of 2016 (as amended); International Companies Act No. 1 of 1992 (as amended, including the International Companies (Economic Substance) (Amendment) Act No. 15 of 2019); Companies (Amendment) Act 2017 requiring a beneficial ownership register; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act No. 10 of 1993; Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2014; and the VFSC Regulatory Framework for Registered Agents.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each proposed shareholder, director, and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority in the UBO's country of nationality

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement issued within the last three months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Originating utility provider or regulated financial institution

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police certificate of good conduct from each jurisdiction of residence over the preceding ten years
Professional bank reference letter confirming an active account relationship and customer standing

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All proposed shareholders, directors, officers, signatories, and UBOs must be screened against the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit domestic sanctions list, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the OFAC SDN List, the UK HMT sanctions list, INTERPOL red notices, and the VFSC enforcement register. Politically exposed persons (PEPs), as defined under Section 3 of the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 11 of 2016, trigger enhanced due diligence, requiring source-of-wealth evidence, senior management approval, and strengthened ongoing monitoring. All screening is mandatory prior to incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Name Reservation and Search Portal (www.vfsc.vu / VFSC e-Registry)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: An International Company name must be expressed in romanized characters. The VFSC accepts names in English, French, or Bislama; any non-Latin script must be transliterated/romanized before filing. The name must include a legal indicator such as 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation', 'Corp.', 'Incorporated', 'Société Anonyme', or a permitted abbreviation, and may not be identical or deceptively similar to any name already reserved or registered in the VFSC register.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A successful name reservation may be extended before expiry by filing a renewal application with the VFSC and paying the prescribed renewal fee (VUV 2,500, approximately USD 22). If the VFSC formally rejects a proposed name, the applicant or licensed registered agent may file an administrative appeal within 30 days of the rejection notice, addressing each stated ground with documentary evidence and paying the VFSC appeal fee (VUV 5,000, approximately USD 45). Simultaneous resubmission under a materially distinguishable name is permitted. The Registrar will assess whether the name is prohibited, sensitive, or likely to mislead.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is operationally permissible for a remote BPO call center, but the International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu supplied by a VFSC-licensed registered agent. The virtual location may serve only as the statutory registered office and administrative address; the actual business and functional management may remain offshore. The BPO's principal operational centre may be located outside Vanuatu without creating automatic local taxable presence, provided that no management and control, data hosting, or revenue-generating activity is legally transacted within Vanuatu and the company maintains the required economic substance record where applicable.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: Low to moderate (approximately 5-10% in the first year) for a low-risk offshore BPO with no Vanuatu-sourced revenue and no physical facilities. Nonetheless, VFSC and the Financial Intelligence Unit retain statutory discretionary and unannounced inspection powers; such likelihood increases if banking, money transmission, or data processing is performed in-country or if an adverse AML/CFT risk rating is applied by the registered agent.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the VFSC Fees Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (undisclosed mandatory agent fee)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/KYC due diligence, UBO register preparation, and sanctions/PEP screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed compliance service provider / corporate secretary

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille, and consular legalization bundle for shareholder and director documents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the VFSC Levies Regulations

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992, as amended (Vanuatu), Parts II and III governing incorporation, registered office and registered agent requirements; the domestic Companies Act [Cap. 191] does not apply to International Companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (constitutional document) lodged by a VFSC-licensed registered agent with the Registrar, upon which the Certificate of Incorporation is issued under section 14 of the International Companies Act.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; the Articles must authorize at least one share (with or without par value) and no escrow account or paid-in capital deposit is required for registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscriber(s) named in the Articles of Incorporation be, and are hereby, allotted one ordinary share each in the share capital of the Company, and the Register of Members shall be updated accordingly. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company be fixed at the office of the registered agent in Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu, and the registered agent be appointed to act for the Company. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name of Director] be appointed as sole Director and [Name of Secretary] as Company Secretary, each to serve subject to the Articles. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Director is authorized to open banking accounts, execute contracts, and do all acts necessary to effectuate these resolutions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Incorporation Name Clearance and Registry Search
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry (submission via a VFSC-licensed registered agent in Port Vila)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent submits three proposed corporate names to the VFSC Registrar for pre-clearance against the International Companies Register, checking for identical or deceptively similar names and prohibited words. A successful name is reserved for 60 calendar days.
required_dossiers: Three proposed corporate names in order of preference
Client due diligence / KYC form of the ultimate beneficial owner
Certified passport copies of proposed shareholder(s)
Engagement letter appointing the VFSC-licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as deceptively similar, the agent re-submits the next preferred name within the reservation window; no additional state fee applies to the first two resubmissions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting of Articles of Incorporation and Consents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent / corporate service provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Articles of Incorporation in conformity with the International Companies Act, including the authorized share structure, an objects clause covering offshore BPO, call-center helpdesk and tele-sales services, and the registered office address. Consent-to-act forms are executed by the first director, company secretary, and registered agent.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Incorporation
Consent-to-act of first director
Consent-to-act of company secretary
Registered agent consent and registered office confirmation
Name reservation confirmation from Step 1
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where VFSC raises non-compliance comments, the agent amends the Articles and resubmits within 7 business days; additional drafting fees, if any, do not delay the registration window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing and Government Fee Payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent lodges the incorporation package with the VFSC online registry and settles the USD 350 government incorporation fee plus VFSC processing charges through a bank transfer.
required_dossiers: Signed Articles of Incorporation (notarized)
VFSC application for registration of an International Company
Statutory declaration of compliance executed by the registered agent
Consent-to-act forms from Step 2
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is queried as incomplete, a perfecting affidavit or supplemental declaration is lodged within 14 calendar days; a one-time refiling charge may apply only if a new case number is issued.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registrar examines the submitted package, enters the company into the International Companies Register, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation stating the company number, date of incorporation, and the Company's legal personality as an International Company.
required_dossiers: Approved Articles of Incorporation
Receipt of payment of state fees
Certificate of Incorporation (issued output)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Typographical or name errors on the certificate are cured by a Certificate of Correction issued by the Registrar upon a written request within 5 business days of issuance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: First Board of Directors and the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The initial director convenes the first board meeting, adopts the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution, approves the allotment of subscriber shares, enters statutory registers, authorizes the corporate bank account application, and arranges the corporate seal if desired.
required_dossiers: Certified Certificate of Incorporation
Minutes of the First Board Resolution
Register of members, directors, and secretaries
Share certificate template and consent of banker's signatories
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Defective minutes or erroneous share allotments are re-executed within the same incorporation period; where a bank queries beneficial-ownership documentation, the KYC file is supplemented and the application resubmitted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Annual Compliance, Business License, and Physical Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC; Port Vila Municipal Council; Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The company files its annual return and pays the VFSC annual license fee before 30 June each year; where it maintains an in-country office, it obtains a municipal business license from the Port Vila Municipal Council and schedules fire-safety and occupational health inspections for the premises.
required_dossiers: VFSC annual return and annual license fee receipt
Municipal business license application (where physical premises exist)
Fire safety inspection application
Occupational health clearance verification checklist
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late annual fee penalties (statutory surcharge) may be waived only on written application to VFSC in exceptional cases; failed fire inspections are re-inspected at no additional state fee within 30 days after defect remediation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No sectoral industrial licensing board applies to offshore BPO call-center activities; general oversight is exercised by the VFSC Registrar of International Companies and, for in-country premises, the Port Vila Municipal Council under the Municipalities Act.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable - the offshore BPO call-center scope is exempt from a dedicated statutory operating license; the Company operates under the Certificate of Incorporation and the annual VFSC license, with a municipal business license required only for physical premises in Vanuatu.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation, Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy and Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: EIA Exempt / Registration Only - administrative and call-center office use is not a scheduled development activity requiring a full Environmental Impact Statement under the Environmental Protection Act No. 12 of 2002.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No point-source industrial discharges are permitted without a DEPC discharge permit; standby diesel generator emissions must meet ambient air-quality limits; e-waste, UPS batteries, and spent IT hardware must be segregated and exported to licensed recyclers in compliance with Basel Convention obligations; HVAC maintenance must prevent release of ozone-depleting refrigerants.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification by the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Service covering means of egress, alarms, and extinguishing equipment; structural load inspection of the premises by the Public Works Department Building Inspectorate; workplace occupational health clearance under the Employment Act No. 1 of 2010, including first-aid, emergency evacuation, and operator work-station ergonomic checks.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department (VIRD), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official e-services portal at https://www.vird.gov.vu (supplemented by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) company registry for International Companies; customs declarations via the Vanuatu Customs Asycuda World electronic single window).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax, so no income TIN is required. The VFSC Certificate of Incorporation bearing the International Company (IC) registration number serves as the statutory identifier. A separate VAT identification number is obtainable only where the IC makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu; the non-resident offshore IC is not within the VAT net because the International Companies Act (Cap 222) prohibits domestic trading. If voluntary/exigible VAT registration were sought (e.g., after domestic conversion under the Companies Act), the entity must file Form VF 224 with VIRD, attaching the incorporation certificate, registered office certificate, directors/shareholders register, and projection of taxable turnover, with decision within 14 working days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone - A Vanuatu International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act (Cap 222) is absolutely exempt from all Vanuatu taxes, duties, stamp duties, and levies on income, profits, capital, assets, distributions, and share transfers. The exemption is written into the statute and is not dependent on a ruling. The IC is a non-resident offshore vehicle prohibited from acquiring assets in Vanuatu or trading with Vanuatu residents, thereby remaining outside the territorial VAT and customs regime.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, flow-through, or hybrid mismatch election regime exists in Vanuatu. The only statutory elections are (i) voluntary VAT registration under the VAT Act (Cap 247) for a person making taxable supplies; and (ii) conversion of an IC into a domestic company under the Companies Act (Cap 191), which prospectively forfeits offshore tax exemption. Under Section 357 of the International Companies Act, a converting IC retains a 20-year tax exemption on pre-conversion operations. No GAAR-related hybrid election is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the VAT Act No. 12 of 1998 (Cap 247), administered by VIRD; customs duties under the Customs Act (Cap 249) for physical imports.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 4,000,000 (four million vatu) of taxable supplies in any consecutive 12-month period; no separate distance-selling threshold for intangible/offshore BPO services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, continuous transaction control, API stamping, or digital stamping mandate exists in Vanuatu. Hard-copy tax invoices are legally sufficient; electronic invoices are permitted but voluntary and are not transmitted to VIRD. Customs export declarations for physical goods are lodged through the Asycuda World portal, but services escape customs formalities.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies under Section 11 of the VAT Act to (a) goods exported from Vanuatu; and (b) services supplied to a recipient who is outside Vanuatu where the benefit of the supply is received outside Vanuatu (offshore/exported services). The remote BPO call center (multilingual inbound helpdesk and outbound tele-sales) qualifies where the contracting counterparty is a non-resident entity, the service is rendered from Vanuatu to foreign clients, and no recipient of the benefit is present or consuming the service within Vanuatu. Critical evidence: written master service agreement with the foreign principal, itemized invoices referencing the offshore contract, IP routing/telephony records showing foreign call destinations, and inbound foreign-currency payments from overseas.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Asycuda World format) - mandatory only for physical goods; for pure services, a detailed Service Export Schedule substitutes
Bill of Lading or Master Air Waybill evidencing goods left Vanuatu (goods) or client delivery/usage records abroad (services)
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT MT103/credit advice evidencing foreign currency receipt from the non-resident client
Zero-rated VAT tax invoice bearing supplier VAT registration number when registered, plus the dated Service Agreement
Packing List and Commercial Invoice for goods; for BPO services, a Detailed Service Statement with call traffic/log data
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VIRD may audit export zero-rating claims for up to five years from the return date. Where export status is disallowed - if services are in fact consumed by a Vanuatu resident or goods never departed - the supply is recharacterized as taxable at 12.5%, with interest accruing at 2% per month on the unpaid VAT and a civil penalty of up to 150% of the shortfall. Fraudulent zero-rating (false declarations, forged inward remittance certificates, sham offshore contracts) triggers criminal prosecution under the VAT Act with fines up to VUV 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to seven years, plus retrospective clawback, deregistration for VAT, and joint and several liability of directors of the International Company.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains a liberal exchange-control regime under its Exchange Control Act and the supervisory framework of the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu. The vatu is convertible for both current account and capital account transactions through authorised dealers. There are no general exchange-control approvals, conversion quotas, or profit-remittance restrictions applicable to a Vanuatu International Company. Dividends, service fees, royalties, and liquidation proceeds may be freely repatriated once the paying bank has completed standard KYC/AML verification of beneficial ownership, source of funds, and the underlying commercial purpose. The practical frictions are bank-level due diligence and correspondent-bank compliance requirements, not statutory exchange controls.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory export-proceeds surrender requirement and no mandatory conversion ratio for export or export-service receipts in Vanuatu. BPO call-centre service receipts may be retained 100% in foreign currency or converted into vatu through an authorised dealer. The only requirement is accurate transaction reporting to the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu for balance-of-payments statistics and to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit for AML/CFT purposes.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (VUV); Operational VUV/USD current account
Operational USD current account; segregated client money account for BPO collections
Operational VUV/USD account; foreign currency settlement account
Operational current account; USD fixed-term liquidity buffer

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium as a supplementary settlement rail, Low as a substitute for a licensed bank account. Offshore digital EMIs are not licensed banks in Vanuatu and cannot provide regulatory capital escrow, VUV-denominated clearing, or local deposit protection. They are legally usable for USD/EUR B2B payables and receivables via virtual IBANs provided the entity maintains a downstream authorised-dealer bank account, records all flows for audit, and never treats the EMI as the sole repository for shareholder capital or client funds.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: There is no statutory mandate that all directors must appear physically in Vanuatu. Risk-based remote onboarding is permitted under Vanuatu's AML/CFT framework. A licensed bank will normally require a live video KYC interview with directors and beneficial owners, notarised or certified passport copies, proof of address, a professional bank reference, and certified corporate registry extracts. Some institutions may require one authorised signatory to attend at a Port Vila branch for signature verification, but a low-risk remote BPO International Company can usually complete onboarding through a combination of video KYC and certified corporate documentation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque beneficial ownership chain involving non-resident shareholders or nominee directors
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current International Company certificate, certificate of incumbency, share register, nominee declaration or declaration of trust, passport pages of all beneficial owners, professional reference from a licensed corporate services provider, source-of-wealth statement, and sanctions-screening results.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Banking purpose mischaracterised as unspecified offshore trading or remittance pass-through
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Service agreements with BPO clients, staffing and operations overview, expected monthly invoice volume, pricing model, cost breakdown, delivery-location summary, telecom infrastructure contracts, and a treasury forecast showing the full fund-flow cycle.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party remittance inflows from overseas clients or aggregator platforms creating unexplained counterparty risk
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Client onboarding files, executed master service agreements, invoices with unique reference numbers, payment reconciliation reports, aggregator agreements for Wise B2B or similar rails, and counterparty KYC declarations proving commercial purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expatriate directors and small equity base with high collection value from call-centre operations
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolutions, audited or management accounts, payroll and subcontractor contracts, utility and telephony carrier invoices, insurance certificates, tax-registration confirmation, negative-news review, and a written AML/CFT manual with employee due-diligence procedures.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder funds must be remitted by SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's own bank account to the International Company's account at an RBV-licensed authorised dealer. The payment narrative should state 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION / ISSUANCE OF SHARES' and, where a purpose code is required, should be mapped to the receiving bank's balance-of-payments category for equity or direct-investment capital, commonly corresponding to SWIFT ISO purpose 'CFIB' or the bank's internal direct-investment code. The onboarding file must contain the board resolution authorising the share issue, updated share register, share certificates, bank deposit confirmation, statutory declaration of source of funds, and final UBO information. Cash deposits, crypto transfers, and third-party pass-through accounts are not acceptable for capital injection.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operational disbursements for the remote BPO call centre should be cleared through SWIFT MT103 from the licensed VUV/USD operating account for high-value payroll, telephony, software, and corporate payables. Low-value cross-border B2B payments may use Wise B2B or similar compliant EMI rails when the receiving counterparty has a verified business account. A commercial letter of credit is not normally applicable to pure call-centre services; if the corporate group also procures IT or telephony hardware for delivery to clients, a sight documentary credit issued or confirmed by an international bank may be used for the goods portion, while the service component remains a separate SWIFT MT103 remittance.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable VUV/USD forward contracts with an RBV-licensed authorised dealer, limited to contracted BPO receivables and committed operating costs.
Cross-currency swaps between VUV and USD with a licensed commercial bank, used only for matching long-term capital or financing cash flows of the International Company.
Plain-vanilla FX options with a licensed bank for hedging confirmed portfolio-level exchange-rate exposure, if offered by the dealer.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not generally available onshore; where an offshore bank proposes an NDF, it must be documented as a derivative with no VUV settlement and must be explicitly approved under the company's treasury policy and confirmed as permissible by the onshore authorised dealer.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return under Section 52, International Companies Act (Cap. 222)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after the anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment attracts a penalty of up to 20% of the annual fee; continued default for more than 3 months may trigger administrative strike-off by the VFSC, and resumption requires a court restoration order plus all outstanding fees and penalties

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is mandatory for any Vanuatu International Company regardless of size; audit becomes compulsory only if the constitutional documents so require or if ordered by the Supreme Court on a shareholder application
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutorily prescribed accounting framework; ICs must maintain records that correctly explain transactions and financial position, with IFRS commonly adopted for voluntary financial statements

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No standalone UBO annual return is filed; the registered agent must collect and retain beneficial ownership information under VFSC AML/CFT obligations, and the annual return confirms the current directors, shareholders, and registered agent. Share transfers are recognised only by entry in the Register of Members upon approval and stamping of the instrument of transfer where applicable

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 – USD 4,500 if voluntarily conducted (not mandatory)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no payroll tax, and no wealth tax. An International Company is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu income taxes and operates under a permanent Tax-Exempt Zone classification. Export-oriented BPO and call-centre services are outside the Vanuatu VAT net as exported services; no tax holiday application or preferential ruling is required to secure the 0% rate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return form exists in Vanuatu. The only recurring statutory government filing for a non-licensed International Company is the VFSC Annual Renewal and Compliance Return, submitted electronically by the licensed registered agent through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Online Services portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; there are no provisional quarterly CIT instalments, no estimated tax payments, and no annual CIT reconciliation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Renewal and Compliance Return and the associated annual government fee are due on or before the anniversary of the company's incorporation date in each calendar year. The deadline is calculated by reference to the original certificate of incorporation, not a Vanuatu tax-year end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name and VFSC registration number as set out in the certificate of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact registered English name of the International Company; no Vanuatu tax identification number is required unless the company voluntarily registers for VAT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Vanuatu maintained by the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The address must be a physical Vanuatu address, not a PO Box, and must be the office of the appointed licensed agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Licensed registered agent name and VFSC agent licence number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Vanuatu-licensed registered agent must be appointed and maintained for the entire lifespan of the International Company; provide the agent's current licence reference.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors and company secretary details, including full names and residential addresses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: There is no nationality or residence requirement for directors of an International Company; however, a licensed company secretary must be appointed and listed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Beneficial ownership register declaration: ultimate natural-person owners, shareholding percentages, and source of funds.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclosure to the registered agent is mandatory for AML/CFT compliance. The beneficial ownership register is not publicly filed but must be physically maintained at the registered office for inspection by VFSC or law enforcement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration confirming that the International Company has not conducted prohibited domestic business in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a remote BPO call centre, declare that all services are rendered to non-resident clients, that no Vanuatu-source revenue is derived, and that the company has not traded with Vanuatu residents without a special permit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual government fee calculation based on authorised share capital and fee schedule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent will normally compute and pay the fee in VUV or USD; payment must clear before the anniversary date to avoid late filing penalties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or late renewal of the annual VFSC compliance return triggers a prescribed administrative late filing charge, a monthly default surcharge on the unpaid government fee, and continued default can result in compulsory strike-off of the International Company. Directors and officers may be personally fined on summary conviction and disqualified for repeated non-compliance.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has not entered into any comprehensive double taxation agreements. Because Vanuatu levies no withholding tax on dividends, no treaty relief form, no double tax agreement application, and no Vanuatu Tax Residency Certificate is required to remit profits from an International Company. For bank compliance purposes, the directors should approve a written distribution resolution and maintain audited or internal accounts showing profits available for distribution.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding tax on cross-border royalties and debt interest; Vanuatu also imposes no interest equalisation tax. There are no treaty-reduced rates because Vanuatu lacks an operative double tax treaty network. Where a parent jurisdiction taxes royalty or interest income, any foreign tax credit will be governed by the parent jurisdiction's unilateral foreign tax credit rules, not by Vanuatu treaty law.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: 0 VUV — no statutory transfer pricing documentation threshold applies because Vanuatu does not impose corporate income tax and has no transfer pricing legislation. As a matter of prudent substance documentation, an International Company should nevertheless prepare a contemporaneous Local File and, if part of a multinational group exceeding EUR 750 million consolidated revenue, a Master File and country-by-country report may be required by the ultimate parent jurisdiction.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu does not operate a separate Economic Substance Regulations statute comparable to Caribbean OFC regimes. However, the VFSC and the International Companies Act require an International Company to establish and maintain a registered office, a licensed resident agent, and adequate corporate formality. For an offshore BPO call centre, economic substance should be demonstrated through locally held board meetings, a director or manager exercising real decision-making, invoicing and payment flows administered from Vanuatu, and written service contracts with the foreign BPO client. A bare shell with no office, no records, and no decision-making can be struck off and will create a foreign controlled-foreign-company or substance-shame risk for the ultimate beneficial owners.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsely describing domestic Vanuatu services as exported BPO services in order to claim zero-rating or to evade Vanuatu VAT, or using the International Company shell to conceal taxable commercial activity of a Vanuatu-resident operator.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Value Added Tax Act and the criminal code, the company may be assessed three times the evaded tax, fined up to VUV 2,000,000, and its directors subjected to imprisonment of up to seven years. VFSC will revoke the International Company's exempt status and may order judicial strike-off.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly approve false returns or fraudulent invoicing risk personal civil restitution for the evaded tax, travel bans preventing departure from Vanuatu, director disqualification for up to ten years, and custodial sentences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating an International Company with a nominee agent only, no physical office, no corporate records, no Vanuatu decision-making, and all BPO services performed entirely outside Vanuatu by third parties while the company is used as a conduit to avoid foreign tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The VFSC may impose striking-off, require liquidation, revoke incorporation, and the courts may declare the company's transactions void against creditors. The company may also be disqualified from banking with VFSC-authorised corporate service providers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be made personally liable for unconscionable distributions, required to restore misapplied company money, disqualified for up to ten years, and placed on a travel ban pending satisfaction of civil judgment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain the beneficial ownership register, failure to submit suspicious transaction reports to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit, or knowingly processing wire transfers from customers whose tele-sales revenues derive from fraud, scams, or money laundering.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Act, the company may be fined up to VUV 25,000,000, proceeds of crime may be confiscated, and the International Company may be ordered wound up. The VFSC may cancel the registered agent's licence and report the company to the FIU.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shadow directors who fail to report suspicious activity are subject to personal fines for each unreported transaction, civil claims for restitution by victims, travel bans, disqualification, and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a call centre that in substance conducts payment aggregation, third-party fund holding, foreign exchange conversion, crypto-asset exchange, or investment dealing on behalf of clients without holding a VFSC International Dealers Licence or Financial Dealers Licence, while marketing the activity as a mere BPO helpdesk.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Carrying on a regulated financial activity without a licence is a criminal offence under the International Companies Act and the Financial Dealers Licensing Act. The court may order immediate cessation, void the offending contracts, disgorge profits, impose fines, and strike off the entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shadow directors face personal civil liability for investor losses, confiscation of advisory and transaction fees, travel bans pending criminal trial, disqualification, and imprisonment for continued operation of the unlicensed business.
